fields.name: Timer
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x32EA1A0 (size 4, default 0). bg3.exe+0x32E9BD0 (esv::unsheath::LockPickingSystem) writes 0x3FC00000 (1.5 s) right after creating/refreshing it, then every tick subtracts the frame time (GameTime+8, scaled by an optional per-entity time factor; 0 while paused) and removes the component when the value is <= 0. The resolver bg3.exe+0x32F1AD0 tests presence only and adds reason 0x10 with Sheathed.
